title: Adaptive Detoxification: Safeguarding General Capabilities of LLMs through Toxicity-Aware Knowledge Editing
reasoning: The paper focuses on LLM detoxification to align models with human values and the 3H principles (helpful, honest, harmless). It evaluates the model's adherence to ethical guidelines by measuring its ability to refuse harmful prompts while maintaining general capabilities, which constitutes a core component of evaluating AI ethics.
